recognize_zh: 低倍下可見多個大而淡染、形狀相近的結節彼此擠壓排列，只被細纖維帶分隔，結節內缺乏淡暗分區與清楚套區，是濾泡性淋巴瘤腫瘤性濾泡「背靠背」的結構特徵。
features: Large, pale-staining nodules of similar size crowding the field
Back-to-back arrangement with thin fibrous septa between nodules
Absent or attenuated mantle zones and no light/dark zone polarity
Nodules composed of a monotonous-appearing population at this magnification
Small portion of colonic mucosa at upper left corner
describe_en: At low power, the submucosa is replaced by large, pale, closely packed nodules of relatively uniform size separated by delicate fibrous bands. The nodules lack distinct mantle zones and show no germinal center polarization, and interfollicular areas are compressed. A small portion of colonic mucosa is present at the upper left. The architecture is suggestive of follicular lymphoma; cytologic grading and immunophenotyping are required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, show dark/light zone polarization with tingible-body macrophages and have well-formed mantles.
MCL nodules consist of monotonous small cells with irregular nuclei, often with naked germinal centers, and are cyclin D1 positive.
NLPHL nodules are larger and moth-eaten by scattered LP cells in a small B-cell background and lack the CD10+/BCL2+ neoplastic follicle phenotype.
